item.title: Dimensional Backpacks Add-On
item.creator: Pixelusion
item.description:
Dimensions into craftable backpacks! Just hope nobody picks it up while you're inside…

+ YOUR OWN PORTABLE BASE, ALWAYS ON YOUR BACK!
+ Stabilize them or they go BOOM!
+ Randomly generated Trial Dimension!
+ Wearable Nether Portals!
+ Epic Dimensional Tools, Weapons & Mobs

Beware of dimensional threats…

faqEntries.heading: Why won’t Backpacks the portal open?
faqEntries.content:
For Dimensional Backpacks, open it and use a Recovery Compass on it. Once the portal appears, jump into it. 
For Trial Backpacks, check the question below!

faqEntries.heading: How do I load Trial Backpacks?
faqEntries.content:
Use either of the following items to load it, each one will create a different dungeon size.
- Stabilized Ender Pearl: Small dungeon
- Stabilized Ender Eye: Medium dungeon
- Dimensional Eye: Huge dungeon!

faqEntries.heading: What does a Trial Backpack do?
faqEntries.content: It opens a randomly generated dungeon filled with battles and rewards. Reach the Void Vault to collect your prize and open the exit.

faqEntries.heading: Does my Backpack keep my items?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Pick it up, carry it, and place it again. Your items stay inside the same Backpack.

faqEntries.heading: Will carrying my Backpack around erase my base inside?
faqEntries.content: No. Built enviroment and storaged items always stay inside Backpack. You can pick it up as an item, move around, place it down and everything will be the as it was before picking it up.

faqEntries.heading: What is Dimensional Stability?
faqEntries.content:
Each Dimensional Backpacks has a stability level, the bigger it is the more unstable it will be!
Destabilize it using Ender Pearls or Chorus Fruits, and stabilize it using Stabilized Ender Pearls or Ender Eyes.
Raising instability will spawn more dimensional monsters you can slay to obtain crafting material, but be careful: if it gets too high it becomes unsafe and might even explode!

item.howToTitle: Unlock The Power Of Pocket Dimensions!

howToEntries.heading: Carry It Your Way
howToEntries.content:
Wear your Backpack, place it down, and take your base wherever you go. 
Use a Recovery Compass to load a Dimensional Backpack, then step inside your own hidden base.

howToEntries.heading: Take On Trial Dungeons
howToEntries.content:
Enter the Trial Backpack and conquer a mysterious dungeon filled with danger.
Fight your way to the Void Vault and claim the treasures that wait inside. 

Dungeons are RANDOMLY GENERATED, making each adventure unique!

howToEntries.heading: Wear a Nether Portal On Your Back
howToEntries.content: Carry your Nether portal everywhere you go. Yes, everywhere.

howToEntries.heading: Defeat The Dimensional Eater…
howToEntries.content: Mess with Huge Dimensional Backpacks instability to summon it!
